outcome: Quality of life (QOL) measured by Incontinence Impact Questionnaire-7 (IIQ-7) scores
cohort: The study involved 145 gynecologic cancer patients who underwent hysterectomy between 2008 and 2013.
finding: The rates of both urinary incontinence and overactive bladder increased after gynecologic cancer surgery, with mixed incontinence being associated with a lower quality of life.
mod_finding: The study does not mention mode of birth as an exposure or outcome.
